notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have been moved.

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: An unexpected error occurred. You can try again or return to the home page.

workout.gentle: No rush — start when you're ready. If the time passes, it just slides 20 min later on its own.
workout.shifted: Nudged it a little later for you. Come whenever it suits you — take your time.
workout.capped: That's it for today. Even a few moves count; skip to tomorrow if today's full.
workout.celebrate: You moved today — nice one 🎉 See, that was easy.

goals.createTitle: Set a goal with a deadline
goals.levelHint: The more specific, the better AI matches your real starting point.

levelPlaceholder.study: e.g. total beginner / can read simple sentences
levelPlaceholder.exam: e.g. never studied it / mock score 5.0
levelPlaceholder.weight: e.g. barely exercise / active once a week
levelPlaceholder.skill: e.g. complete novice / know the basics
levelPlaceholder.other: e.g. roughly where you are now

goals.aiHint: AI splits the time from today to your deadline into progressive stages, and adjusts along the way based on your pace — no pressure, take your time.
goals.deleteConfirm: Delete this goal and all its stages?
goals.paceBehind: A little behind is fine — AI will ease the pace and shore up the basics.
goals.paceOnTrack: Right on pace. Keep going steadily.
goals.paceAhead: You're ahead! AI will bump things up a bit to push toward the goal.
goals.toastCreated: Goal created — your stage roadmap is ready
goals.toastReplanned: Re-planned the upcoming stages based on your progress

timeline.saveHint: Sign in to save this routine so it's here next time.

saved.title: My routines
saved.subtitle: Routines you save show up here, ready to load anytime.
saved.empty: No saved plans yet. Head to the timeline to create and save one.
saved.signInPrompt: Sign in to save and view your routines.

toast.loadError: Failed to load, please try again

habits.title: My habits
habits.subtitle: Start with the smallest step, check in daily, and watch your streak grow.
habits.signInPrompt: Sign in to create habits and check in every day.
habits.empty: No habits yet. Add your first one and start small.
habits.deleteConfirm: Delete this habit and its check-in history?
habits.minHint: Start small so it's easy to keep, then increase gradually.
habits.toastCreateError: Failed to add, please try again
habits.toastBumped: Leveled up, one step at a time!
habits.toastEased: Eased off — let's solidify the basics first
habits.aiTitle: Break a big goal into tiny habits
habits.aiSubtitle: Enter a bigger goal and AI splits it into small daily habits you can actually finish.
habits.aiGoalPlaceholder: e.g. Get good at English, run a half marathon, write daily
habits.aiFallbackHint: AI is unavailable; used a built-in template for you.
habits.aiEmpty: No suggestions — try rephrasing your goal.
habits.pendingBannerAll: {{count}} tiny habits still pending today — knock one out now 💪
habits.pendingBannerDone: All tiny habits done for today. Amazing! 🎉

reflect.title: Today's reflection
reflect.subtitle: Write down how today felt and where you got stuck — I'm here with you.
reflect.signInPrompt: Sign in to write reflections and revisit them anytime.
reflect.empty: Say whatever's on your mind today. Done it, didn't, tired, frustrated — it all deserves to be taken seriously.
reflect.intro: A habit just means doing something has become the path of least resistance for you. Missing it is normal — let's look at what's affecting you, instead of blaming yourself.
